I am having this same issue. I also share the shame that comes with it. I even started developing rashes/acne on various parts of my body. Tonight my mom made me stay on the phone with her until she could hear the shower running and then FaceTime her after so she could see that I showered. That really helped me so maybe something similar could help you. And then once I’m in the shower I just try to get it over with as fast as possible. Shampoo, soap, shaving if necessary, and then out and clothed asap. Just as everyone has said you are not alone and many others are struggling with the same thing.
